dialogues.speaker: Yrjo
dialogues.text: Relax, I'm taking care of it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So many people lining up to enter the harbor, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Yrjo
dialogues.text: Well, pal, there are always way too many people waiting to enter the harbor, and the queue times have always been a little... Well, sometimes it's slow, and sometimes it's very slow.

dialogues.speaker: Yrjo
dialogues.text: And the conveyor belt's broken, too. I guess when it rains, it pours, and when it pours, the roof starts leaking buckets...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What problem are you taking care of?

dialogues.speaker: Yrjo
dialogues.text: A huge pile of problems, that's what. Lost or damaged goods, unregistered people, a new species of critter that neither been registered nor quarantined...

dialogues.speaker: Yrjo
dialogues.text: *sigh* Is the rest of Teyvat this chaotic and messy as well?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it, then. Good luck.

dialogues.speaker: Yrjo
dialogues.text: I won... So, shall we play another round, pal?

dialogues.speaker: Yrjo
dialogues.text: Not only is work endless, but I can't even figure out how to play cards properly. Guess it never rains but it pours...
